Senses.Explanation: This stock appraisal pictures redundant commerce: trying to peddle all of Yangzhou while already inside one’s own house. Guoqing Ying applies it to Zhaozhou and Nanquan, Pang Yun places it in a raised encounter, and Wuyi Yuanlai uses it in verse. Across these retained uses, the phrase keeps the impossible redundancy of selling a whole place from inside it; the surrounding case decides whom the appraisal addresses.
